source_hash_pins.hash_rule: Canonical SHA-256 over UTF-8 JSON serialized with ensure_ascii=false, recursively sorted keys, and compact separators (comma and colon).
source_hash_pins.whole_file_hash_rule: The separate authorization amendment must pin this exact input file SHA-256 over raw UTF-8 bytes including its final newline, as well as the whole preregistration file SHA-256.

candidate.allowed_runtime_change: Selection-only retention of first-seen PMIDs from already-attempted relaxation rungs; query construction, sort, rung definitions/order, stop threshold, retmax, metadata fetching, PMC preference, maintained ToolConfig/ResponseParser, and max_papers remain fixed.

fixed_settings.maintained_tool_config_and_parser: same exact maintained ToolConfig mapping and ResponseParser across both arms; amendment must pin their source/config hashes and prove identity before calls

isolation.processes: Run the exact pinned baseline and candidate MCP builds in separate isolated loopback child processes. The future amendment must record each PID, port, imported source path, commit/tree/build hash, effective tool configuration, parser hash, trace flag/build ID, and listener ownership.
isolation.caches: Use an empty, non-overlapping cache namespace for every request_id × arm. Verify file_count=0, metadata_count=0, and first_ids=[] before every call; retain same-call supplementation only.
isolation.network_retries: Pin zero retries at every transport layer and at Bio.Entrez. The offline amendment must inject one retryable transport failure per arm and prove exactly one attempted request before the runner stops.
isolation.tracing: Require per-call trace at the expected arm cache path, matching request, arm, build, run ID, exact query, sort, every attempted rung, selected/fetched/final ID lineage, and empty pre-search pool.

run_artifact_paths.collision_rule: If any output path or run/slug identity already exists, stop before call 1 and issue a new dated preregistration; never overwrite or append an ad hoc suffix.
